notes: Shane Stone (finisher: the Phenomenal Ending) and Eric Cameron (finisher: the Showstopper), managed by the Phenomenal Army — see the Managers line below for the full, shifting roster, per the team's own 2014 NAPW application. Toured New Alberta Pro eWrestling May–Dec 2014 (see the NAPW wing) as this same billed pairing — Wayback-mined 2014 cards confirm the run start to finish, dated and carded. The team's own claim to being "7-time GIWF tag team champions" doesn't reconcile with the registry's own count of 6 real reigns (3x World Tag Team + 3x North American Tag Team, all in data/reigns.json) — the seventh is the foam "Universal Tag Team" belt they gave themselves and, per the user's own account, glorified above all 6 of their actual title wins. Receipted: their own GIWF bio page describes each man as "always" wearing his "Universal Tag Team Title belt" in the physical-appearance prose — conspicuously absent from the SAME bio's own Accomplishments list a few paragraphs later, which sticks to the 6 real reigns. A joke worn with a completely straight face, in-fiction and in the bio copy alike.
